prospective_note: the units already existed when this protocol was frozen; this stratum is a shadow over the owner's most recent traffic, not a prospective run, and no claim from it may say otherwise
unit: one non-merge commit reachable from the default branch, newest first; head = commit, base = parent
truth: product-blind adjudication into adjudication.jsonl (unit_id, finding_id or empty, label defect|not_defect|unresolved, reviewer, evidence); unknown truth stays unresolved
retries: none; a unit that cannot run is recorded with its DEFER reason
silence_reporting: every silent unit records units_read and units_total; a silence over a partly-read commit covers only what was read
code: the window tip including D-124, D-125 and D-126; stratum v1 ran before all three and is reported apart
